I am a young woman with a small wheat plot here in SNNP. The land is ours, which is good, but 0.16 hectares is not much, so I must use it well. I will try to get some DAP and urea from the cooperative like most of us do, though the amount depends on what they bring and what I can afford — I cannot put as much as the extension workers say. I also spread manure from our animals because it is free, and I save seed from last year since improved wheat seed is hard to find and costs too much. I do the work myself with help from my family; we cannot afford to hire people for such a small plot, and we depend on the meher rains since we have no irrigation.
